lots.what_it_is: Four Midwinter Stylecraft Fashion Shape 'Tonga' coffee duos (matt black cups, black and white striped saucers, 1960s, backstamp read) plus four graduated cream canisters with black lids and an aluminium band, script letters C, T, R, F. The canisters are the same model as a five-piece retro plastic set sold at Gowans, so the Sugar (S) one looks to be missing.

sold.note: Page opened (API JSON) and lot photo checked. Lot 382658 '5 vintage graduated retro plastic kitchen canisters': the same rectangular canister model with lid, aluminium band and script letters F S R T C, but in orange and a full set of five. Ours are cream, four pieces (no S). Canisters only, no cups. Within 24 months.

asking.price: GBP 8.01 or best offer, one Tonga Fashion Shape duo
asking.note: Snippet only, page returns 403 so not verified; kept only as a lead. Rate 1 GBP = 1.914 AUD (open.er-api.com, 19 Oct 2026). Single used duo, UK freight extra.

asking.price: Collector guide: cups and saucers GBP 5 to 15 (also an eBay Zambesi Fashion Shape duo at GBP 19.99)
asking.note: Page opened. About the sister Zambesi pattern on the same Fashion Shape; Tonga not mentioned. Midpoint GBP 10 at 1.914 = about A$19 per duo; range A$10 to 29. Guide, not a price paid.

lots.dropped_entries: Gowans 427220 '4 retro canisters' $25: photo checked, these are stoneware jars with cork lids, not our canisters. Gowans 403731 'set of retro canisters' $40: photo checked, teal anodised aluminium with flower decals, different item. The-saleroom Midwinter page 63 (claimed Fieldings GBP 170 Zambesi service, 2023): page opened, no such lot shown (only a 2018 Gerrards Tonga plates lot with no price); unverified, older than 24 months and a different pattern, dropped. Antiques Atlas Alphabet Antiques Tonga beaker GBP 95: page opened, real sold-marked dealer listing but for the scarcer 1950s tube-lined Tonga beaker, a different product from Fashion Shape duos, and the GBP 285 vase was not seen; dropped. No Midwinter, Stylecraft or Tonga lots exist in the Gowans API. WebSearch budget was used up, so no new Armitage site search was possible this turn.
lots.guide_summary: Thin. One SOLD close match (the same canister model in orange, five pieces, $27 hammer at Gowans, Dec 2025) and two ASKING guides for the duos (about A$15 to 19 each, one snippet-only). Nothing unsold. Rough whole-lot picture: canisters about $20 to 30 hammer locally, duos maybe $10 to 15 each at retail asking, so perhaps $40 to 80 all up on a good day. GBP at 1.914 AUD.
lots.working: keep: lowest same-model SOLD = $27 (canisters only, a full five vs our four) / 1.22 = $22.13, round down to $20. Covers the canisters only; the duos have no sold evidence. flip: likely resale about $27 at a local room, less about 15% vendor commission ($4) = $23, / 2.44 = $9.43, round down to $5. Not a realistic flip.
lots.confidence_reason: Backstamp read clearly, but only one SOLD entry and it covers only the canisters, in a different colour and a fuller set. Duo values rest on asking and guide evidence, one of them snippet-only.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 2: saucer backstamp reads '"TONGA" Stylecraft Fashion tableware by Midwinter Staffordshire England'. Photo 1: four Fashion Shape duos, matt black cups with white interiors, striped saucers; no chips seen at this resolution. Canisters lettered C, T, R, F in script, cream bodies, black lids, aluminium bands; the matching Gowans set had an S too, so Sugar looks missing.
lots.condition: Looks used but tidy in photos; no visible chips or crazing on cups at web resolution. Canister set incomplete (4 of probably 5). Canister material not confirmed (likely plastic).
lots.score_reason: Common 1960s Midwinter pattern plus an incomplete set of retro canisters; local evidence puts the whole lot in the $30 to 80 band.
lots.question_for_armitage: Are any of the cups or saucers chipped, cracked or crazed? Are the canisters plastic, and is there a fifth (Sugar) canister with the set?
